notes.title: Announcement of SHOOTING STAR VR Release Date!
notes.notes:
🏹 Hello, warrior! 🏹

Following Archery Land, Looksten is releasing a sequel!

SHOOTING STAR VR is a story where you become a hero and wield a magic bow to rescue the goddess of Archery Land, who has been kidnapped!
It will be released on April 20th!

👇Please click "Add to Wishlist" below!👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350290/SHOOTING_STAR_VR/

🎯We ask for your continued interest in SHOOTING STAR VR!🎯

notes.title: [Archery Land] Patch Note (Ver 0.8)
notes.notes:
Happy New Year, Warriors!
Archery Land Team is here! 

Below is the Ver 0.8 update patch for January 9, 2023.

** Ver 0.8 update highlights    ** 

1. Changed the size of the character's head.    

* Quadrupled!

2. Changed the ‘language’ select button to 2D UI  


 3. Changed the list of tutorial guide   

* Each of ‘how-to’ guide for the Bow and Arrow will be shown one by one (not shown at the same time)   
* 3 practice targets (not 1) 

 4. Changed the main UI   

* Enjoy 3 different modes!      
* Enjoy 6 different rank games! 
* Enjoy trying to challenge the Boss stage anytime! 

 5. Changed Rank game UI      

* the ranking and score will be shown      

 6. Changed Multi-game backgrounds   


 7. Changed Multi-game interaction way      

* Hold the bow to start the game      
* Select the target button, not the coin 

We updated with your feedbacks of value.
Thank you for enjoying Archery Land


Good Luck,
Archery Land, Warriors! 


Thank you
Looksten

notes.title: [Archery Land] Patch Note (Ver 0.7)
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.
This is the Archery Land Team.

Please check out updates for Ver 0.7 on Friday, 14 October 2022.

Important features
1. Some changes for the beginning scene.

 Added a new opening level.
 Added a new tutorial level.


2. Some changes for the main UI.

 Changed ‘play-console’ to 2D UI.
 Updated for Ray-cast & Selection method.


 3. Updates for the avatar hand.

 Updated for the avatar hand modelling and the avatar gloves modelling.


 4. Updates for the avatar bow & arrow.

 Updated for the bow & arrow modelling and the hitting effect.


 5. Updates for the target.

 Updated for the target modelling and the hitting effect.



We have updated Ver 0.7 with your valuable feedback.
On be half of the development team,  we would like to express our sincere thanks to everyone who loved our game!


Good Luck,
Archery Land, Archers! 

Thank you
Looksten

notes.title: [Archery Land] Patch Note (Ver 0.6)
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.
This is the Archery Land Team.

Please check out updates for Ver 0.6 on Friday, 16 September 2022

Important features
    1. Some changes for the tutorial

 The shark will jump out when hitting the target in the tutorial! 


    2. Some changes for the temple.

 The temple door is closed
 The 2 pictures of the game story will be shown on the temple's door.
 Added a function of 'touch the Shark Statue' to activate the temple. 


  3. Updates for the vibration when shooting the bow.

 Added vibration when calling the bow.
 Added vibration when shooting the bow.
 Updated for vibration when pulling the bow.


Good Luck,
Archery Land, Archers! 

Thank you
Looksten
